MechanicsCorrections: Actual suspension-ray extension rate uses contact-normal-relative chassis/ground motion, not the tilted chassis-up projection of horizontal travel.
Engine drag opposes actual signed driven carrier rotation. Traction control scales propulsion only, not passive engine drag.
Authored tire grip, sliding tail, suspension rates, CG, chassis angular drag and steering parameters are unchanged. No random spin or added yaw force.

Controls.Q: Shift down; accepted requests enter Manual. First-to-neutral is allowed while moving; drive engagement from neutral/reverse is stopped-only.
Controls.E: Shift up; accepted requests enter Manual.
Controls.M: Toggle Automatic/Manual without changing selected gear or direction.
Controls.R: Stopped reverse/first selector at world-speed magnitude at or below 0.5 m/s.
Controls.S: Service brake in forward and reverse.
Controls.Neutral: No propulsion or engine braking transmitted to axles.
Controls.Reset: First gear, preserving chosen transmission mode.
Controls.DownshiftSafety: Reject manual downshift before mode/gear mutation if inferred coupled RPM would exceed redline.
Controls.RevLimiter: Propulsion cut at redline, released 100 RPM below; algebraic engine model, not an integrated clutch.

ArchitectureLimitations: Engine RPM/launch and shifting remain algebraic; no engine/transmission clutch inertia, synchronization, stalling, clutch-kick or shift-duration simulation.
Reverse road traction control is not implemented; forward propulsion assistance remains explicit.
Small-slip lateral tire stiffness is not calibrated against load; tire relaxation, wear, temperature, pressure and measured-data calibration remain deferred.
No measured axle-specific anti-roll/camber/Ackermann geometry or calibrated chassis inertia.
Moving ground velocity is observed, but dynamic platforms do not receive equal/opposite vehicle reaction forces.
AWD has equal center torque distribution, not a center differential model.
Rolling-resistance/contact-reaction energy balance still needs separate calibration.
No added yaw, automatic steering, grip override, brake-to-drift or maintained-speed drift force.
